data.description: Main analysis file - yearly country panel with all debt, fiscal health, and risk signal columns merged. ~180 countries from 2000 to present.
data.name: sovereign_debt_panel

fields.name: year
fields.title: Calendar year

fields.name: country
fields.title: Country name (standardised via World Bank)

fields.name: iso3_code
fields.title: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code

fields.name: region
fields.title: World Bank region (South Asia, MENA, ...)

fields.name: income_group
fields.title: High / Upper-middle / Lower-middle / Low

fields.name: govt_debt_pct_gdp
fields.title: Gross govt debt as % of GDP (IMF: GGXWDG_NGDP)

fields.name: govt_debt_usd_bn
fields.title: Gross govt debt in USD billions (IMF: GGXWDG)

fields.name: external_debt_usd_bn
fields.title: External debt stocks in USD billions (WB)

fields.name: external_debt_pct_gdp
fields.title: External debt as % of GDP - calculated

fields.name: debt_per_capita_usd
fields.title: Govt debt per person in USD - calculated

fields.name: fiscal_balance_pct_gdp
fields.title: Net lending/borrowing as % of GDP (IMF: GGXCNL_NGDP)

fields.name: primary_balance_pct_gdp
fields.title: Primary balance before interest as % GDP (IMF)

fields.name: govt_revenue_pct_gdp
fields.title: Government revenue as % of GDP (IMF: GGR_NGDP)

fields.name: interest_payments_pct_gdp
fields.title: Interest payments on debt as % of GDP (IMF)

fields.name: interest_pct_revenue
fields.title: Interest payments / revenue - debt-trap signal

fields.name: foreign_reserves_usd_bn
fields.title: Foreign exchange reserves in USD billions (WB)

fields.name: reserves_to_external_debt
fields.title: Reserves divided by external debt - solvency buffer

fields.name: sp_credit_rating
fields.title: S&P sovereign rating (AAA to D)

fields.name: sp_rating_numeric
fields.title: S&P rating as integer: AAA=21 down to D=0

fields.name: imf_program_active
fields.title: 1 = country under an active IMF loan program

fields.name: imf_loan_usd_bn
fields.title: IMF disbursement amount in USD billions

fields.name: sovereign_default_event
fields.title: 1 = a sovereign default occurred this year

fields.name: debt_crisis_risk_score
fields.title: Composite 0-100 risk score (debt + interest + reserves)

data.description: ML-ready feature matrix - all main panel columns plus lag features (1 and 2 year), 3 and 5 year rolling averages, rolling std deviation, YoY absolute and percentage changes, and a binary next-year risk target.
data.name: ml_features
